issues.description: The Farm.singFarmSongVerse method has inconsistent visibility across artifacts: the UML in the problem statement and the template declare singFarmSongVerse as private, but the solution implementation declares it as protected. This divergence is structural (method visibility) and can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and expected method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either (A) change the solution's singFarmSongVerse signature to private to match the UML and the template (preferred if encapsulation was intended), or (B) update the UML and the template method declaration to protected if tests or other classes need access. Apply the same visibility everywhere so students are not confused about the required method signature.
